title: Social Media Specialist
summary: Shape strategies, create viral content and run day-to-day social operations for leading Hong Kong brands.
responsibilities: Outline goals and define target audiences with appropriate social media and digital platforms to convey clients' messages
Formulate and implement sales and marketing strategies with action plans
Assist clients to identify issues, trends and opportunities to create viral content
Develop, manage and update brands' social media accounts
Support the daily operation of engaging and promotional content development, ad boosting and ad placements across all social platforms
Contribute to idea generation and execution of social-media-driven campaigns — videos, social posts, AR filters, KOL engagement and third-party ad placement; occasionally GDN and SEM campaigns
Collaborate with internal and external clients to initiate and execute campaigns and routine content
Improve continuously by capturing and analysing the appropriate social data and insights
Handle ad hoc projects as needed
requirements: Strong research, analytical and writing skills
Good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese

title: Officer — Public Affairs, Social Media & Crisis Management
summary: Work at the intersection of public affairs and social media — spotting issues early and helping brands respond well.
responsibilities: Outline goals and define target audiences with appropriate social media and digital platforms to convey clients' messages
Formulate and implement social media strategies with action plans
Assist clients to identify issues and manage social media sentiment
Develop, manage and update brands' social media accounts
Support the daily operation of engaging and promotional content development, ad boosting and ad placements
Contribute to idea generation and execution of social-media-driven campaigns — videos, social posts, AR filters and KOL engagement
Collaborate with internal and external clients to initiate and execute campaigns and routine content
Improve continuously by capturing and analysing the appropriate social data and insights
Handle ad hoc projects on a request basis
requirements: Strong research, analytical and writing skills
Familiar with the ecology of different online forums and social platforms
A good sense of public affairs and social issues

title: Research Analyst — Social Media
summary: Monitor the conversation, find the signal and turn it into reports clients act on.
responsibilities: Monitor social media posts daily
Prepare insightful reports regularly for clients
Detect potential crises and prepare ad hoc reports for clients
requirements: Good communication, analytical and report-writing skills
Familiar with various social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Threads and forums
Good team player — proactive and able to work independently
Task-oriented, deadline-driven and able to manage multiple projects
Excellent written and spoken Chinese and English
